name: AUTOPILOT.OI All 6 Money Agents
description_html:
All 6 Money Agents for Claude. $60 if bought separately, $39 here.

  • Credit Agent: audits your credit reports, writes disputes, tracks every deadline
  • Bill Agent: checks medical bills against your insurance before you pay
  • Debt Agent: lower rate call scripts, payoff plan, what to pay every payday
  • Subscription Agent: finds every recurring charge and writes the cancel messages
  • Refund Agent: finds money you're owed and writes refunds and disputes
  • Raise Agent: logs your wins, finds your number with real pay data, rehearses the talk

Each one: the full master prompt, 5 starter prompts, a step by step 10 minute setup and a tracker. Works with Claude's free or paid plan.

Education only, not financial, legal or medical advice. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic.
